steps.title: Configure plates and pipette
steps.instruction: Select the source and destination plate formats, place the destination plate in the correct deck slot (384‑plate → slot 2, 96‑plate → slot 1), load source plates into slots 3‑9, keep tip racks in their default positions, set the starting tip index (e.g., 8 = H1, 10 = B2), choose the pipette (use P300 if the global transfer volume > 20 µL, otherwise use P20), and prepare a CSV file whose header reads: Source plate barcode, Source plate slot (3-9), Source well, Dest plate barcode, Dest well, Transfer Vol (ul).

substeps.instruction: Select source and destination plate formats.
Place a 384‑well destination plate in deck slot 2; place a 96‑well destination plate in deck slot 1.
Load source plates into deck slots 3 through 9.
Leave tip racks in their default positions.
Set the starting tip position (e.g., index 8 corresponds to H1, index 10 to B2).
If the global transfer volume is > 20 µL, select the P300 pipette; otherwise select the P20 pipette.
Create a CSV file with the header: Source plate barcode, Source plate slot (3-9), Source well, Dest plate barcode, Dest well, Transfer Vol (ul).

steps.title: Input global transfer volume
steps.instruction: Load the prepared CSV into the protocol and have the software read the global transfer volume for each source‑to‑destination transfer as specified in the file.
